difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the limit of a compatible inverse system of finite flat modules over a system of rings with surjective transition maps and locally nilpotent kernels is finite projective over the limit ring, and that base changing it back recovers every stage. The proof uses that the limit pair is henselian and lifts the first module to a finite projective module over the limit ring, then successively lifts the comparison maps using projectivity to obtain a map from that module into the limit; writing the projective module as a direct summand of a free module makes its limit description available, so it suffices to check that the induced maps at each stage are isomorphisms, which follows from the finite projectivity of the stages and the isomorphism lifting result.
